_comment: What proves bytes in this tree: every external piece, pinned. tools/setup.sh provisions and checks it; tools/disc.py extract/rebuild/check the disc.

disc.name: Azure Dreams.bin
disc.track: MODE2/2352, single data track (SLUS_006.14, Azure Dreams (USA))

compilers._comment: the seven stock cc1 drops (decompals/old-gcc release 0.17); toolchain/compilers/ holds these and nothing else

assembler.maspsx: vendored at tools/maspsx (MIT, base github.com/mkst/maspsx; carries the delay-slot store scheduling and %lo-fold fixes the matches depend on; function-blind: no name tables, no per-function options); toolchain/maspsx is a symlink to it
assembler.gnu_as: mipsel-linux-gnu-as from the host binutils-mipsel-linux-gnu package (2.42 observed); invoked by maspsx --run-assembler and by tools/build/as.sh

mkpsxiso.why: the disc's primary volume descriptor carries abstract/bibliographic identifiers (KONAMI); stock mkpsxiso drops them and the image is not byte-identical

python.host: python3 >= 3.10 with PyYAML importable by the system interpreter (the window gate runs under python3, not the venv)
python.tests: cd tools/maspsx && ../../.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q   (aspsx/ tests need the proprietary ASPSX binary and are not run)
